outside_scope_leads: Numerous exact per-example dates/labels should be checked before reuse; some source chronology appears mismatched.
Modern benchmark comparisons, specific software identity and unprecedented novelty are unsupported background claims.
No substantive examination of June18XSSform/cookie payloads despite broad exploitation title.
Fine-grained host counts and exact output-token size are not independently verified.
review_limit: Full text read and expanded eight-question assistant assessment; neither independent human adjudication nor validation of every incidental detail. Historical per-run input provenance remains a limit.
